flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (empty COURT block), pages/Report/index.tsx + ActionReport.tsx (court report menus without a path), pages/Notice/form/History.tsx (Court Application History tab commented out). ocmsadminapi: crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (entity only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: 1-point story: a control/action to go back to the previous screen from the confirmation screen of the reviewed notice list (Epic 22 court application). The sheet says Fully paid, but the code has no court application screen at all: the COURT route in App.tsx:313 is empty, there is no review/confirmation page, no Back control tied to this flow, and no endpoint for a court notice list. The words court application / court batch only appear as report menu labels without a path (Report/index.tsx:62-67), a commented-out History tab (History.tsx:170-172) and parameter menu entries (Meta/System.ts). Searched with court application, courtbatch, court_batch, court-batch, CourtReferral across the six repos. No maintenance ticket touches this screen.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The code has no court application review/confirmation screen or Back action; ask URA/the team in which repo this is built, or mark it as a gap

steps.step: The confirmation screen shows the reviewed notice list and the notice count summary
steps.detail: The COURT block in App.tsx:313 contains only an empty comment, there is no Route for a court application review or confirmation page. Grep for court application / courtbatch in ocmsadminui only finds report menu labels without a path and a commented-out History tab. There is no screen that could host a Back control.

steps.step: The officer uses an action to return to the previous screen
steps.detail: There is no Back/Cancel control tied to the court application flow. The only UI trace is CourtApplicationHistoryGrid (History.tsx:71) whose tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172), so it is inactive. Generic browser/menu navigation exists, but it is not the feature the story names.

steps.step: The reviewed notice list is shown again so the officer can continue reviewing
steps.detail: No API stores or returns a selected-notice list for court application. OcmsCourtCase only stores notice_no, court_payment_due_date and reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:21-31), not a review list. The only related lookup is court case by csd_batch_no for notices already at summons stage (useSearch.ts:144-150), which is a different feature.
